LEAVE AND LICENSE AGREEMENT

1. The Licensor grants the Licensee the use of Flat 12, Lake View, Nagpur, for eleven months from 1 August 2026.

2. The Licensee shall pay a monthly licence fee of Rs. 18,000 and a refundable security deposit of Rs. 54,000, returned within 30 days of handing back the premises.

3. The Licensor or his agents may enter the premises at any time, with or without notice, to inspect them or show them to buyers.

4. Either party may end this agreement by giving one month's written notice to the other.

5. The Licensee shall pay electricity charges as per the meter; society maintenance is paid by the Licensor.

RENTAL AGREEMENT

1. The Landlord lets the flat at 5 Park Street, Kolkata, to the Tenant for twelve months at a monthly rent of Rs. 22,000.

2. The Tenant pays a security deposit of Rs. 1,32,000. The Landlord may deduct any amount from the deposit at his sole discretion, and the balance, if any, will be returned when the Landlord finds convenient.

3. The Tenant shall give three months' notice to vacate. The Landlord may ask the Tenant to vacate with fifteen days' notice.

4. Rent is due on the 1st of each month. A late fee of Rs. 500 applies for every day of delay.

LEAVE AND LICENSE AGREEMENT

The Licensor allows the Licensee to occupy Flat B-7, Green Acres, Bengaluru, for eleven months on a monthly licence fee of Rs. 30,000 and a security deposit of Rs. 90,000.

The Licensee shall carry out all repairs to the premises, including structural repairs, plumbing and the water tank, at the Licensee's own cost.

The Licensee shall not keep any guest overnight for more than two nights in a month without the Licensor's written permission.

The agreement may be renewed only on terms decided by the Licensor.

OFFER OF EMPLOYMENT

Dear Ms. Rao,

We are pleased to offer you employment as a Junior Analyst with Brightline Analytics Private Limited at an annual salary of Rs. 6,00,000.

1. Probation. You will be on probation for six months, which the Employer may extend at its sole discretion.

2. Service bond. You agree to serve the Employer for at least three years. If you resign before that, you shall pay the Employer Rs. 3,00,000 as liquidated damages towards training costs.

3. Notice. After confirmation, either party may end employment with sixty days' notice.

4. Leave. You are entitled to eighteen days of paid leave each year.

EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

This agreement is between Orbit Software Limited (the Employer) and Mr. Kabir Shah (the Employee), who joins as Software Engineer on a monthly salary of Rs. 95,000.

1. For two years after leaving the Employer for any reason, the Employee shall not work for any company in India that builds software, and shall not contact any client of the Employer.

2. The Employee assigns to the Employer all inventions, including those made outside working hours with the Employee's own equipment.

3. Working hours are 9 a.m. to 6 p.m., Monday to Friday. The Employee is entitled to twenty days of paid leave each year.

4. Either party may end this agreement with one month's notice.

APPOINTMENT LETTER

You are appointed as Sales Executive with Meridian Retail Limited on a gross monthly salary of Rs. 35,000, effective 1 September 2026.

1. The Employer may terminate your employment at any time without notice and without giving any reason. You must give the Employer ninety days' notice if you resign.

2. Your variable pay may be recovered from you if you leave within one year of receiving it.

3. You may be transferred to any office or associate company of the Employer anywhere in India.

4. Probation is three months. Leave is as per company policy.

PERSONAL LOAN AGREEMENT

This agreement is between Swift Finance Limited (the Lender) and Ms. Anjali Mehta (the Borrower).

1. Loan. The Lender lends the Borrower Rs. 3,00,000 at a floating interest rate that the Lender may revise from time to time.

2. Repayment. The Borrower repays in 36 equated monthly instalments (EMIs) of Rs. 10,200 by auto-debit.

3. Prepayment. The Borrower may close the loan early only after 12 EMIs, on payment of a foreclosure charge of 6% of the outstanding principal.

4. Default. If any EMI is late, penal interest of 3% per month, compounded monthly, applies to the overdue amount.

LOAN AGREEMENT

The Lender, Cityline Credit Private Limited, agrees to lend the Borrower, Mr. Ravi Kumar, Rs. 5,00,000 for 48 months at a fixed interest rate of 14% per year.

1. If the Borrower misses a single EMI, the entire outstanding loan, with interest for the full term, shall become immediately due and payable.

2. The Borrower authorises the Lender to share all loan and personal information with credit bureaus and any third party the Lender chooses.

3. The Borrower shall buy a life insurance policy from the Lender's partner insurer, and the premium shall be added to the loan.

4. A processing fee of 3% of the loan amount is payable and is non-refundable.

CONSUMER DURABLE LOAN TERMS

The Borrower borrows Rs. 60,000 from Easypay Finance Limited (the Lender) to buy a refrigerator, repaid in 12 monthly EMIs of Rs. 5,400.

1. Fees. A processing fee of Rs. 2,500, a documentation fee of Rs. 1,000 and a bounce charge of Rs. 750 for each failed auto-debit are payable. The Lender may add any other charges from time to time.

2. Interest. The interest rate is 0% for the first three EMIs and 28% per year after that.

3. Collateral. The refrigerator is hypothecated to the Lender until the loan is fully repaid.

1. Disputes. Any dispute between you and Snapnote shall be resolved only by binding arbitration in Singapore. You waive any right to join a class action.

2. Your content. You grant Snapnote a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide licence to use, copy and sell any content you upload.

3. Changes. We may change these terms at any time without notice, and continued use of the Service means you accept them.

4. Account. We may suspend or delete your account at any time for any reason.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS OF SERVICE

These terms govern your subscription to StreamPlus (the Service) and your user account.

1. Your subscription renews automatically every month and your card is charged until you cancel. You can cancel only by calling our helpline during office hours.

2. Payments are non-refundable, including for months you did not use the Service.

3. We collect your viewing history, location and contacts and may share them with our advertising partners.

4. Our total liability to you for any claim is limited to Rs. 100.

USER AGREEMENT

This user agreement applies to everyone who opens an account on the Marketly platform (the Service).

1. You shall indemnify and hold harmless Marketly, its directors and employees against all claims, losses and legal costs arising from your use of the Service, whether or not you were at fault.

2. Marketly is not liable for any loss caused by sellers on the platform.

3. These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, and only its courts may hear any dispute.

4. You may delete your account by writing to support@marketly.example.

WEBSITE DESIGN SERVICES AGREEMENT

This agreement is between Pixelcraft Studio (the Designer) and Hill Bakery (the Client) for the design of the Client's website for a fee of Rs. 80,000.

1. The Client pays 50% before work starts and 50% on delivery. Payments delayed beyond 15 days attract a penalty of 2% per week.

2. The Designer may assign this agreement to any other agency without the Client's consent.

3. This agreement renews automatically for another year unless the Client cancels in writing 90 days before the end date.

4. The Designer's total liability is limited to the fees paid.

MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

This agreement is between Alpha Robotics LLP and Beta Sensors Private Limited, each a party, who wish to discuss a possible joint project.

1. Each party shall keep the other's confidential information secret and use it only to evaluate the project.

2. Confidential information does not include information that is public or that the receiving party already knew.

3. This agreement lasts two years from the date of signing. Either party may end it with thirty days' written notice.

4. Notices go to the addresses written below the signatures. Disputes go to the courts of Mumbai.
The tenant pays rent of Rs. 10,000 each month.

GRANDMA'S MANGO PICKLE

Wash and dry two kilograms of raw mangoes. Cut them into small pieces with the skin on, and remove the seeds.

Mix the pieces with salt and turmeric and leave them in the sun for a day. Roast fenugreek and mustard seeds, grind them coarsely, and add red chilli powder.

Heat mustard oil until it smokes, let it cool, and pour it over the mangoes and spices. Store the pickle in a clean glass jar and shake it every day for a week before eating.
